source_caption_text:
When Quavo and Offset squashed their beef and reunited to honor Takeoff at the BET Awards

Via @bet

The 2023 BET Awards gave hip-hop one of its most emotional moments when Quavo and Offset reunited onstage to pay tribute to their late Migos brother, Takeoff. It marked their first performance together since his passing in November 2022, coming after months of reported tension between the two.

The tribute opened with Takeoff’s verse from “Hotel Lobby” playing as an empty spotlight stood between Quavo and Offset. A rocket ship then appeared on the screens before transforming into an image of Takeoff. The two went on to perform “Bad and Boujee,” turning the emotional tribute into a celebration of the music they made together.

Offset later revealed that the entire performance came together in just 15 to 16 hours, with both artists working on the staging and visuals. He also said the tribute was done out of love for Takeoff and that performing together helped clear his soul.
